课程名优先使用大字，空间充足时再显示老师和地点。点击课程，该卡片会弹性展开，其他: Class names use larger text. Teachers and rooms appear when space permits. Click to expand just that card with a spring animation, showing times, period count and known period details. Click outside or press Esc to close.
调整左侧导航的顺序，保存后立即生效。: Reorder the left navigation. Changes are saved immediately.
软件默认打开日程，home 在导航最上方。个人记录保存在这台电脑上，无需注册账号: The app opens Schedule by default, with Home first in navigation. Records stay on this computer, with no account required. Daily quotes may use the internet.
轻轻停留，看看今天: Pause a moment, see your day
输入密码，打开属于你的田园。: Enter your password to open your garden.
还没填，当前按月折算: Not set; using the daily budget scaled for this month
还没有习惯，下面新建一个。: No habits yet. Add one below.
还没有习惯，先添加一项每天想坚持的事。: No habits yet. Add something to do every day.
还没有生活任务，上面一行就能加: No personal tasks yet. Add one above.
还没有记录，上面记一笔试试。: No entries yet. Record an expense above.
这一天的日记暂时无法打开，请重试。: Could not open this diary. Please try again.
这个半天还没有节次，点\"加一节\"添加: No periods yet. Choose Add period.
这个月还没有照片。点开一天的日记，添加你的第一张照片。: No photos this month yet. Open a day's diary to add your first photo.
这个月，留下了 {0} 天的心事。: You kept your thoughts on {0} days this month.
这些选项以后都能在设置里调整。: You can change all these options later in Settings.
这里决定\"自动化安排任务时，哪些时段可以用\"。你的课程时间会被自动避开，不用: Choose the intervals available for automatic task scheduling. Classes are avoided automatically, so you do not need to list them here.
这里可以写下日记、天气与心情。月历里的每一句封面，都是属于你的日常。: Write your diary, weather and mood here. Each calendar cover is a piece of your everyday life.
这里的时间决定课表显示、\"该去上课了\"的提醒，以及自动排程时哪些时段算被你占: These times control timetable display, class departure reminders and busy periods for scheduling. Save to apply without restarting.
这项任务已不存在，请关闭后重新选择。: This task no longer exists. Close and select another.
进入「设置 → 外观与桌面 → 字体与月历」，独立选择应用字体和月历封面字体，也: Settings → Appearance & desktop → Fonts & calendar lets you choose separate app and cover fonts, or enter an installed font name. Preview your choice; it stays after restart.
选一种喜欢的字，让记录更像自己。: Choose a font that makes these records feel like you.
选择分类、填写金额，保存一笔支出。切换日、周、月查看统计；预算按自己的情况设置，: Choose a category and amount to record an expense. View totals by day, week or month. Budgets are optional and can be adjusted to your needs.
通常放在没课的自习时间: Usually scheduled in free study time
部分安排在显示范围外，点击清单查看: Some events are outside the visible range. View them in List.
链接仅用于本次读取，不会保存到软件。预览不会更改现有课表；课程变更后，可重新粘贴: The link is used only for this read and is not saved. Preview does not change your timetable. Paste it again to update changed classes.
附件暂时未能保存，请重试。: Attachment could not be saved. Please try again.
随手记一件生活小事，回车保存…: Note a personal task, Enter to save…
首次进入可选择是否设置密码。点开月历中的一天，写封面、天气、心情和日记。可添加照: On your first visit, choose whether to set a password. Open a calendar day to write a cover, weather, mood and diary. Add a subtitle, photos and files; Album browses photos by month and can export originals. Export a date range as one Word overview or a file per day. Photos use Word; attachments are included. Choose fonts in Appearance & desktop. The bottom-left menu opens navigation; diaries save before leaving.
首次进入可选择是否设置密码。点开月历中的一天，记录封面、天气、心情和正文，添加照: Choose whether to set a password on your first visit. Open a day to record a cover, weather, mood and diary, with photos and files. Switch to Album to browse this month's photos.
默认预览 06:00–24:00，可在设置 → 课程与排程 → 日程时间中修改。: Default preview is 06:00–24:00. Change it in Settings → Courses & scheduling → Schedule hours. Zoom with +/−; reset with Overview. Set a duration and drag onto free time. Drag existing tasks to move them without duplicates. The red line follows the time; class conflicts prevent placement.
